_comment: Technique 2: emptying a whole catalog by replacing the mod's file at its exact path.
SceneCatalogLoader is a SimpleJsonResourceReloadListener, so it resolves one resource per
exact ResourceLocation with the top-most pack winning. This file replaces all 373 shipped
scenes with none, and the mod's copy is never read.
Read the README before enabling this. dynamic.enabled = false in the common config does the
same job more cheaply, reversibly, per install, and without fighting the next mod update.
